tailStart: After existing action work and exact stopped evidence persistence, before TRACE_END/Tracing.end. Existing point/box post-stop proof/capture steps remain unchanged; the added tail itself performs only a host timer wait.
invariants: Persist and hash stopped measurement evidence once; do not stop/read/reconcile again to replace it.
No new browser reads/actions/render markers/RAF or render scheduling during added tail.
No reset/navigation/next sample until trace completion and successful exact derivation/drain.
Keep original ACTION and first eligible final-epoch FEEDBACK, exact containing main-frame/source-frame/origin/layer/current generate-submit and unique full reporter occurrence.
Do not choose a different draw or later presented frame if original is missing/dropped/partial/ambiguous.
Original targets, clock uncertainty, categories, raw cap, EOF/loss guards, IO deadlines and orbit windows remain unchanged. No subtraction of collection time.
Fixed tail is not adaptive, not a retry, not a presentation guarantee. Missing or late evidence at its end remains failure.
Finalize bounded capture and persist original errors even if action/tail fails; do not mask failure or leak trace ownership.

Missing whole retrospective pair, begin-only, end-only and incomplete relevant child are separately rejected; unrelated old/boundary occurrences do not invalidate a complete exact target.

Work failure, stop/persist failure, missing reporter after250ms, transport loss/overflow/deadline fail closed, retain evidence/original error and finish trace cleanup; no adaptive extension or retry.
Keep existing lossless identifiers, actual occurrence uniqueness, same-track reuse, timestamp ties, clock checks and source manifest bindings.
